svg.title: Three ways to place the vision encoder
svg.desc: Three topologies. Aggregated serving runs an aggregated worker on each of four identical GPUs. Colocated encoder runs encoder workers and a PD worker on each of four identical GPUs using MPS. Disaggregated encoder runs encoder workers on two lower-tier GPUs and sends embeddings over NIXL to PD workers on four other GPUs.
svg.text: Three ways to place the vision encoder
